author: Yffe
content:
Type-direct the spec-call narrowing cast (single-file, root cause in thermite-lower/src/lower.rs).

Root cause: the plain_user_spec_call arm in lower_expr's Call path hardcoded 'as u64' on arithmetic/nat-len args regardless of the callee's declared param type, so a recursive spec fn s_dec(n: u32) self-call s_dec(n - 1) emitted s_dec((n - 1) as u64) -> ill-typed Verus (expected u32, found u64), killing the item at L0.

Fix: spec_fn_param_type_map(program) collects each user spec fn's declared param prim-types in source order; threaded via Ctx::spec_fn_param_types into the lower_fn/lower_fn_signature/lower_spec_fn body paths; Ctx::spec_call_param_cast(callee, pos) maps the declared type to u32/u64/usize (bool/absent -> u64 fallback, byte-stable for u64 sites). Both Call-arm casts now read the map and the ends_with short-circuit matches the resolved target. REQ-4 note corrected (false premise removed).

Tests (R-CHAR-3, hand-derived oracle): thermite-lower/tests/divergence_spec_call_param_cast.rs (u32->as u32, usize->as usize, u64->as u64 regression) + forge/tests/divergence_spec_call_param_cast.rs (live verus: u32 recursive spec fn + exec twin + contract-naming fn all L3; broken twin rejects below L3).

Gauntlet: cargo test --workspace 0 failed (no golden regressions); clippy/fmt clean on the three manifest files. Commit (#225), do not push, do not close (critic re-audits).
